meta.contrastMethod: WCAG 2.x relative luminance, hand-computed from sRGB hex; frontend must re-verify with axe-core on the production build
meta.punctuationRule: No em dash or horizontal bar characters in any UI copy

ink.role: Page background, near-black ink. The only full-bleed fill.

copper.role: Energized conductors, active flow, primary actions, focus ring

diagnostic.role: Unserved/shed load, diagnostics, secondary data, the second hue in comparisons

raised.role: Hovered panel rows, active control groups (elevation 2)

overlay.role: Bottom sheet, dialogs (elevation 3). Network is never drawn on this fill.

graticule.role: Engraved construction grid and plate frame. Decorative only, carries no state.

hairline.role: Panel dividers and table rules. Decorative only, carries no state.

deEnergized.role: De-energized lines/buses, removed-element ghost, control boundaries (borders that must meet 3:1)
deEnergized.note: Fails 3:1 on overlay (2.93). Never place network geometry on overlay.

copperHot.role: Binding line core (flow equals rating within tolerance), selected element

copperDim.role: Low-flow energized line (below 25 percent of rating). Non-text only.

diagnosticDim.role: Candidate (not yet built) line in CAS-INT-004, comparison baseline ghost. Non-text only.

fault.role: Infeasible solve, input error, fault marker. Always paired with a glyph and text, never color alone.

pairwiseWarnings: copper vs diagnostic is only about 1.18:1. Energized vs unserved/shed must ALSO differ by stroke pattern, width or glyph (see networkEncoding). Hue is never the sole channel.
copper vs fault is about 1.56:1. Infeasible/fault always carries the fault glyph and a text label.
forbidden: Gradients or glows on the page background
Any fourth accent hue beyond copper, diagnostic and fault

family.name: Archivo
family.importNote: Must be wdth.css. The default/wght.css files carry only the weight axis and cannot produce condensed cuts.
family.preload: Preload the single latin wdth woff2 in index.html to protect LCP

rejectedAlternatives.IBM Plex Sans Condensed: OFL and excellent, but static (7 separate files for the weights) and one fixed width, so display and body need two families
rejectedAlternatives.Barlow Condensed: OFL, but static, fixed width, and its rounded highway-sign terminals read softer than engraved line work
rejectedAlternatives.Sofia Sans Condensed: OFL variable, but weight-only axis; no wdth axis to tune legend vs body width

numerals.status: UNVERIFIED. No source consulted confirms Archivo ships a tnum feature.
numerals.verification: M2 frontend: render '1111.1 MW' directly above '8888.8 MW' in Archivo with tabular-nums and confirm equal advance widths in a production screenshot (or inspect the woff2 with fontTools/Wakamai Fondue).
numerals.fallbackIfFails: Right-align all numeric readouts in fixed-width cells with the unit in a separate span so changing digits cannot shift layout. Do not add a second font family without a creative-director review.

legend.use: Technical legend, plate captions, axis ticks, units

bodySm.use: Inspector descriptions, disclaimers adjacent to results

numericXl.use: Headline result: unserved MW, served energy

grid.philosophy: Asymmetric editorial grid. Network canvas may bleed past margins; text and legend never do. Splits are uneven (5/7, 8/4, 3/9), never 6/6.

legendPlate.mobile: full width minus margins, top-anchored below chapter index

inspectorRail.mobile: bottom sheet with 96px peek, 50vh half, 88vh full

radius.rule: No pills, no rounded cards. Engraved plates are square-cornered.

styles.plateFrame: 1px solid #16212C with a second inset rule 1px solid #1F2B38 at 4px (double engraved frame)

elevation.method: Surface tint steps plus hairlines. No drop shadows on dark except the overlay level.
elevation.rule: Legend plate and all text sit above every glow layer on an opaque fill. Glow never passes under text.

glow.intent: Low bloom: a tight halo hugging energized copper, not atmosphere

filter.filterUnits: userSpaceOnUse with a region bounded to the network bbox plus 8px

performanceRules: Apply the filter to ONE glow group of duplicated energized strokes that only re-renders on solver state change
Animate flow pulses (stroke-dashoffset) and opacity only on the UNFILTERED core strokes
Never animate filter attributes (stdDeviation, matrix values)
During island separation transforms, fade the glow group to opacity 0 and restore after the transform settles if frame pacing requires it
Never apply a filter to the background, text, or the legend plate

networkEncoding.rule: Every state is encoded by at least two channels: hue plus one of width, dash pattern, glyph or label.

energizedLine.pulse: dash travels in the sign direction of LP flow, speed proportional to |flow| (data drives animation, never the reverse)

bindingLine.casing: double rule: core plus 1px #EF9C54 casing either side
bindingLine.label: AT LIMIT

deEnergizedLine.condition: inside an island with no served load or no generation

removedElement.marker: kerf: 6px gap at each severed end with a short perpendicular cut mark
removedElement.label: REMOVED

bus.glyph: ring r=5 with one radial tick per connected line (degree encoded)

generatorBus.glyph: bus ring plus inner rotor arc; arc sweep = dispatch / Pmax

loadServed.glyph: downward chevron below the bus, length proportional to served MW

loadShedEconomic.glyph: solid wedge on the load chevron, fraction = shed / demand
loadShedEconomic.label: SHED (solver choice under limits)

loadIsolated.glyph: hollow ring with 45 degree hatch fill
loadIsolated.label: ISOLATED (no generation in island)

infeasible.label: INFEASIBLE
infeasible.placement: banner directly adjacent to the result readout

islandSeparation.behavior: each non-main island group translates away from the main island centroid by a fixed 24px (layout aid, labeled in the legend as not a physical quantity)

rules: No count-up number tweens. Displayed values swap at the end of a transition (cross-fade allowed); never interpolate a displayed number from animation progress.
No stagger by graph distance in outage transitions. All elements affected by one LP solve change together, because the engine is single-shot, not a cascade model.
All feedback transitions under 300ms per MOTION_REQUIREMENTS loading/success/error rule.
prefers-reduced-motion: every transition becomes an instant state swap; flow pulses become static arrowheads at line midpoints showing direction.

componentStates.focusRing: 2px solid #EF9C54, 2px offset showing #080D13 between ring and element. Visible on keyboard focus (focus-visible) only, never removed.

pressed.note: Also the touch feedback state (no hover on touch)

disabled.reason: Inline reason text in textMuted directly below, never tooltip-only

loading.indicator: 2px copper rule sweeping under the label (opacity/transform only)

afterReset.feedback: aria-live polite: 'Baseline restored', 240ms copper flash on the legend plate frame

dragging.readout: value + unit shown above thumb in numericMd

invalid.message: fault glyph + text below, value not committed

slider.keyboard: Arrow = 1 step, Shift+Arrow = 10 steps, Home/End = bounds; commits on change, Worker request is debounced 150ms with cancellation

selectableElement.appliesTo: SVG bus and line hit targets (min 44px hit area via invisible stroke)

focusVisible.add: focusRing drawn as SVG ring/casing; roving tabindex across elements, Arrow keys move along topology

disabled.reason: e.g. removed elements cannot be re-selected for removal

solving.networkTreatment: last result held at 60 percent opacity, no new numbers shown until solved

empty.text: No element selected. Choose a bus or line.

infeasible.text: Infeasible: no dispatch satisfies all limits

missingFixture.text: Fixture unavailable: showing nothing rather than stale values

bottomSheet.peek: 96px, shows active control label + headline readout
bottomSheet.handle: 44px tall drag zone, also a button toggling states via keyboard
bottomSheet.focus: focus moves into sheet on expand, Escape collapses to peek

skipIntro.behavior: Enter/Space jumps to the final intro frame (identical to reduced-motion state)

confirmRemoval.pattern: Inline confirm in inspector (not modal): 'Remove bus N?' with CONFIRM (primary) and CANCEL (secondary)

chapters.name: outage cascades
chapters.archetype: editorial split (canvas-led, network left, fault ledger right)

assetBudget.raster: 0 KB in the experience. Only an OG/social preview image for the case study.
assetBudget.svg: Inline, generated from fixture. Target under 600 DOM nodes for the network at rest (30 buses, 41 lines, duplicated glow group, markers).
assetBudget.3d: None (no GLB, no textures, no WebGL context) unless the M4/M5 kill criterion in ART_DIRECTION.md triggers
templateAssetsToDelete: public/favicon.svg (replace with an original bus-ring favicon)
